player.name: Hose ready
player.note: Steady hands, breathing, weight in the knees.

player.name: Jog forward
player.note: Two-beat run cycle with a stable hose grip.

player.name: Jog backward
player.note: Short retreating steps. Aim stays forward.

player.name: Strafe left
player.note: Lateral footwork with shoulders facing the target.

player.name: Strafe right
player.note: Lateral footwork with shoulders facing the target.

player.name: Dodge roll
player.note: Quick tuck, shoulder roll, then back onto both feet.

player.name: Brace & spray
player.note: Subtle pressure in the shoulders; hands stay on the nozzle.

player.name: Take a hit
player.note: Sharp recoil, a stagger, then recover the grip.

player.name: Knocked down
player.note: Lose balance, fall backward, and land on the ground. Protected.

player.name: Get back up
player.note: Recover from the ground. Protected until control returns.

boss.name: Bad attitude
boss.note: Heavy breathing and a hunched, threatening guard.

boss.name: Heavy walk
boss.note: Planted heels, rolling weight, relaxed elbows. Left leg / right arm forward, then reverse.

boss.name: Turn left
boss.note: Short turning steps. The controller rotates the boss to face you.

boss.name: Turn right
boss.note: Short turning steps. Attacks wait until the boss is facing you.

boss.name: Low sweeping swat
boss.note: Crouch down → rake across player height → recover slowly.

boss.name: Double-fist slam
boss.note: Hands overhead → ground impact → long recovery.

boss.name: Get-away kick
boss.note: Lift the knee → kick forward at the small player → plant.

boss.name: Crushing stomp
boss.note: Raise one foot → stomp the ground ahead → shift back.

boss.name: Stampeding charge
boss.note: Lean in → three heavy stomping steps → brake and recover.

boss.name: Superman slam
boss.note: Jump high → fists-first dive → full-body landing → get up.

boss.name: YC rejection charge
boss.note: Deep crouch, gathering light between the hands, then a huge committed blast.

boss.name: Deploy agents
boss.note: Raise a casting arm and command the marked swarm drops.

boss.name: Deadline stomp
boss.note: Brace on the left leg → chamber the right knee → drive the heel down → rock spikes tear through the marked cone.

boss.name: Water stagger
boss.note: Recoil from a face full of water, then regain composure.

boss.name: Freshly washed
boss.note: Inspect clean hands, admire the jacket, strike a proud pose.
